WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(project_count) AS average_count
  FROM project_counts
)
SELECT pc.fundflux,
       pc.project_count,
       1.0 * pc.project_count / t.total_count AS share,
       pc.project_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM project_counts AS pc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE pc.project_count > t.average_count;
